api.title: REST API
api.subtitle: The OpenAPI 3.1 document is generated from the contract; every endpoint is here with its schema and personal token scope.
api.curlHint: Put your personal token in the CREWHALL_TOKEN environment variable; Idempotency-Key makes writing requests safe to retry.
api.typescriptHint: @crewhall/api-client is typed from the same contract: endpoint name, parameters and response are checked at compile time.
api.scopeComment: The token lacks this scope: add it under My account › MCP and API.
api.ruleScope: A token acts with its owner's permissions, limited to the scopes and spaces you picked; each endpoint's description names the scope it needs.
api.ruleNever: Account, security, session, token management and vault endpoints are never open to tokens; moving to the Trash and share links also need a session.
api.ruleErrors: Errors come back as '{ code, message, details? }'; a request outside the token's scopes gets 403 token_scope.
api.rulePaging: Lists use cursors: send cursor and limit, the response is '{ items, nextCursor }'.
